why: ringGymMessage returns early for any channel but Messages-from-your-gym (gymAlertRing.ts:65-66); gym reminders are pre-scheduled on 'gym-reminders' (gymReminders.ts:286-296) and nothing else references that channel for a muted-sound check or warning. OEM silencing itself is device behaviour, not checkable here.

GymWodCard hides only on hidden(=active workout) or no wod (GymWodCard.tsx:41) and workout.tsx:487 passes only hidden={active}; neither gymWodSync.ts nor shop/gymWod.ts has any done/finished check, so the Start card returns after the workout ends.

syncGymPlans skips when asked <10 min ago unless force (gymPlansSync.ts:91) and its only caller WorkoutRoutines.tsx:299 never forces; measures/index.tsx:99 likewise; no push-tap path forces either (no 'workout_plan'/'measurement' handler in apps/mobile/src). Only hits a warm app (throttle is in memory), so narrow.

Every rest-alert run uses one stock emulator: qa-device.yml:249-252 and qa-conditions.yml:235-238 are google_apis/pixel_6; wear-build.yml:288 boots an android-wear emulator alone; test-lab.yml is advisory and keyed (HAS_KEY, live secret not checkable). No OEM image or paired watch anywhere. A test-coverage gap, S3 is right.

member_auto_reminders does drop the reason (0029_auto_reminders.sql:145-164, still the live definition), but the same reasons reach the phone through member_membership (0023:21-26), which the phone already reads, and MembershipCard shows them with the fix ('Check in once to link your membership', name/shared-number/roster lines: shop/membership.ts:121-131). The member is told why; only the link to reminders is unstated.

hq_confirm/hq_reject_mettleup_payment only update status and log (0060_pay_mettleup.sql:308-324), no later migration redefines them or adds a trigger on mettleup_payments, and the panel shows the result only in Settings' PayMettleUpCard (Settings.tsx:67). Migration is marked NOT APPLIED (0060:1), so no live effect yet.

Live trigger _alert_done_enquiry (only in 0098, after every writer) un-handles all 'called' alerts when followUpOn goes from a later day to today (0098_alerts_done_and_read.sql:327-331), and the server's own join/page/invite writers set followUpOn to today on an existing enquiry (0089:108, 0080:362, 0085:86-93), so old handled alerts wait again beside the new one.

runUsageWeekly returns not-set-up/unreachable/status/shape errors without writing anything (deploy/hq/usage.js:97-130); only the success path puts the result (usage.js:134). The System page prints the last stored week (apps/hq/public/app.js:729-730), so a stale date is visible but nothing says this week's check failed.

reply() only console.errors a failed page_chat_reply (deploy/panel/pageChat.js:363-370) and the visitor still gets the answer; page_chat_ask alerts only when take is not ok (0094_page_chat.sql:247) and the needs_you alert for an AI failure is raised only inside page_chat_reply (0094:302); the sweep is a 90-day clean-up, not a retry. Needs the second save to fail after the first worked, so rare.

checksDb maps both 'BILLING off' and 'BILLING on but 0064 missing (PGRST202->NOT_READY)' to the same CHECKS_NOT_READY (deploy/hq/api.js:88-96), and checksCard removes the card on that code (apps/hq/public/app.js:1160-1162); the ready warning text at logic.js:194 is never shown there. Only a half-done setup triggers it.

GoOnlineCard swallows a failed retireOwnerKey with .catch(() => undefined) and moves on (apps/dashboard/src/crm/auth/GoOnlineCard.tsx:173); that is the only caller, and owner_retire_key (0011_signin_fixes.sql:183) is the only delete of gym_owner_keys in any migration, so nothing retries. Needs a failed request at that one moment; the key stays with the owner, so S3 holds.

pay_connections and pay_requests live in the D1 database forgeai-web (deploy/panel/wrangler.jsonc:104-105, migrations/0011_payments.sql:16,35); docs/BACKUP-RESTORE.md:10-12 covers only hq_backup_snapshot of the Supabase tables and never names D1. Cloudflare's own D1 Time Travel likely softens real loss, but nothing documents or drills it.

owner_talk_reply (only definition, 0069_member_messages.sql:323-350) inserts a new message and push on every call with no request id or duplicate check; replyTalk passes only key/thread/text (memberMessagesApi.ts:65-66) and the screen keeps the text on failure so Send can be pressed again (MemberMessages.tsx:243-248).

Offline failures go through markFailed and raise attempts like any other (copySync.ts:217-218, copyLocal.ts:250-255; nextTryAt up to 6 h at copyPlan.ts:229-231); 'internet back' and 'start' only call copyNow, which reads dueOps(now) with next_try_at <= now (copyLocal.ts:236), and nothing resets next_try_at except a new edit of that same item (copyLocal.ts:216). No connectivity check before trying, so offline opens build the wait.

crashReport.ts hooks only the JS global handler and the ScreenErrorBoundary log (crashReport.ts:1-13, 91-106); postCrash sends once and on failure only console.warns (62-77, 60), with no stored copy; a fatal crash waits at most FATAL_WAIT_MS 1500 (19, 102). No native reporter (no Sentry/Crashlytics in package.json, no ApplicationExitInfo or uncaught-exception hook in the app's sources).
